text: Stonefield Primary Ledger needs a real calendar before anything can post to it -- and Theo Branagh builds one around the business, not a default.
The fiscal year runs February 1 through January 31, with twelve monthly periods plus one adjusting period, deliberately skipping a December close during the warehouses' busiest season.
The ledger ties that calendar to the Chart of Accounts, USD, the Standard Accrual subledger method, and Legal Entity Stonefield Distribution Inc.
Journal approval rules route anything over $25,000, or anything touching Retained Earnings or Intercompany, straight to Simone Alvarez before it posts.
Next: configuring Accounts Payable, three-way match, and the Subledger Accounting rule that decides which Cost Center an invoice lands in.
